name: legal-page
title: Legal page
description: A legal page template (terms, privacy), built only from library items: the title and the date it changed, a list of the sections that stays in view, and the sections in a 720px column.
use_for: Terms of service, privacy, cookies. The text is a placeholder: put the terms your counsel approves in lib/pages/legal.ts or pass `content`.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a section
source: Built from the library (site header, footer row) and the brand's type; the section names are the usual ones of a terms page

files.content:
import { FooterRow } from '@/react/components/site/FooterRow' import { SiteHeader } from '@/react/components/site/SiteHeader' import { legalContent, type LegalContent } from '@/lib/pages/legal' import { cn } from '@/react/lib/cn' // A legal page (terms, privacy) from library items: the title and the date it changed, a list of the sections that // stays in view on wide screens, and the sections in a 720px column of DM Sans. The template's text is a placeholder // for the terms your counsel approves: `content` replaces it (lib/pages/legal.ts). export interface LegalPageProps { content?: LegalContent className?: string } const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' export function LegalPage({ content: c = legalContent, className }: LegalPageProps) { return (

{c.title}

{c.updated}

{c.contents}

    {c.sections.map((s) =>
  • {s.title}
    • )}
{c.sections.map((s) => (

{s.title}

{s.body.map((p) =>

{p}

)}
))}
) } export default LegalPage

// The legal page template's copy: the sections a terms page has, with neutral placeholder text to replace with the terms your counsel approves. Both flavors read this file.
const nav = [
	{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
	{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
	{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
	{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
]
const footer = {
	domain: 'spyglass.so',
	links: [
		{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
		{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
		{ label: 'About', href: '/about' },
		{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
		{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
		{ label: 'Terms', href: '/legal' },
	],
}
const header = { nav, secondary: { label: 'Sign in', href: '/sign-in' }, cta: { label: 'Get 50% off', href: '/pricing' } }

const placeholder = (what: string) => `This section covers ${what}. Replace this text with the terms your counsel approves.`

export const legalContent = {
	header,
	title: 'Terms of service.',
	updated: 'Last updated Nov 1, 2026',
	sections: [
		{ id: 'who-we-are', title: 'Who we are', body: [placeholder('who provides the service and how to reach them')] },
		{ id: 'your-account', title: 'Your account', body: [placeholder('creating an account, keeping it secure and who may use it'), 'Each section can hold as many paragraphs as it needs.'] },
		{ id: 'using-the-service', title: 'Using the service', body: [placeholder('what the service may and may not be used for')] },
		{ id: 'plans-and-payment', title: 'Plans and payment', body: [placeholder('plans, billing, renewals and refunds')] },
		{ id: 'ending', title: 'Ending the agreement', body: [placeholder('how either side may end the agreement and what happens to data')] },
		{ id: 'contact', title: 'Contact', body: [placeholder('where to send questions about these terms')] },
	],
	contents: 'On this page',
	footer,
}

export type LegalContent = typeof legalContent
